title: Etale section-source exchange
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring A and any Cartesian base-change square for h with closed sections s and s′ and chosen section square, the prescribed etale source commutes with the actual etale compactification exchange and the supported constant exchange: g* a_c followed by C and F′(beta) equals the scalar-preserving constant pullback followed by a_c′. All maps are those of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps]; no finiteness hypothesis on the new base is imposed.

proof.text: Put $q=js:B\to\bar X$. Since $pq=hs=1_B$, $q$ is a section of the separated map $p$, hence closed by [lem-weil-pbc-section-separated-closed-immersion]. Both $s,q$ are proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper]. The same reasoning applies after arbitrary base change, since $p'$ is proper in the pulled-back compactification [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. In the etale category closed direct images are exact by [lem-cbc-open-closed-recollement], so $Rs_*A_B=s_*A_B$ and $Rq_*A_B=q_*A_B$, with their canonical exact-functor identifications. All these inputs are bounded below.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open: proper/open square with left vertical s and right vertical q; schemes.tex Tag 01KT, lemma-section-immersion

proof.text:
Apply [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] to the square with top $1_B:B\to B$, bottom $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$, left $s$ and right $q$. It gives $e:j_!s_*A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_B$. Its injective normalization is precisely the canonical proper/open arrow stipulated in the statement. Let $d_{p,q}:R(pq)_*\to Rp_*Rq_*$ and $d_B:R(1_B)_*\to\mathrm{id}$ be [lem-cbc-etale-derived-direct-image-coherence]. Define
$$r=d_B\circ d_{p,q}^{-1}\circ Rp_*(e):F_h^e s_*A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B,\qquad a_h^e=r^{-1}.$$
Each factor is invertible. Apply the identical definition to the primed square to obtain $e',r',a_{h'}^e$; these two cited coherence statements hold on arbitrary schemes, so no finite-type hypothesis on $B'$ has entered.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open, defining resolution map; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition

proof.text:
Write $\bar v:\bar X'\to\bar X$. Let $E_s,E_q,E_p$ denote the respective canonical module direct-image exchanges. The exact closed comparison $\beta^e$ is $E_s(A_B)$ under $Rs_*=s_*$: both are the adjunction mate with the same sheaf counit. Equivalently it is the restriction-preserving isomorphism of [lem-pur-etale-closed-constant-tensor]. The base-change equation of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], for the square of Step 2 pulled back by $\bar v$, says
$$E_q\circ\bar v^{-1}e=e'\circ j'_!(\beta^e)\circ\beta_j,$$
where $\beta_j:\bar v^{-1}j_!\to j'_!v^{-1}$ is the specified open comparison. By [def-cbc-exchange-map], $C^e_{h,g}=Rp'_*(\beta_j)\circ E_p$. Naturality of $E_p$ on $e$, followed by this displayed equation, gives
$$Rp'_*(e')F_{h'}^e(\beta^e)C^e_{h,g}(s_*A_B)=Rp'_*(E_q)E_p(Rq_*A_B)g^{-1}(Rp_*e).$$

source.place: Tag 0F7F, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change, commutative diagram; exchange formula of the item

proof.text:
Apply the pasting-along-adjunctions law of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting](2) to the $q$ and $p$ squares, with the constant-module adjunctions and canonical square mates of [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients]. It identifies $Rp'_*(E_q)E_p$ with the exchange for $pq$, conjugated by $d_{p,q}$ and $d_{p',q'}$ of [lem-cbc-etale-derived-direct-image-coherence]. Here $pq=p'q'=1$, so the outer pullback square is the identity on $g$. Its mate is the identity on $g^{-1}$ under the identity-direct-image comparison: the unit/counit formula reduces to the triangle identity (equivalently the identity mate law (4)). Consequently the equation of Step 3, postcomposed with $d_{B'}d_{p',q'}^{-1}$, becomes
$$r'F_{h'}^e(\beta^e)C^e_{h,g}(s_*A_B)=g^{-1}r.$$
Compose on the right with $g^{-1}(r^{-1})$, then on the left with $(r')^{-1}$. This is exactly the asserted etale equality. This argument uses the module mate law itself, without deducing equality of module maps just from a forgetful functor.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_exchange_component [Finite A]
    {B X B' X' : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ B} {h' : X' ⟶ B'}
    {v : X' ⟶ X} {g : B' ⟶ B} (sq : IsPullback v h' h g)
    (c : Compactification h) (s : B ⟶ X) (s' : B' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    (hs : s ≫ h = 𝟙 B) (hs' : s' ≫ h' = 𝟙 B')
    (sqS : ChosenCartesianSquare g s' s v) :
    (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (etaleSource A c s hs).hom ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap A sq c).app
        (etaleSupported A s) ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map (etaleBeta A sqS) =
    (constantPull A g).hom ≫ (etaleSource A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs').hom
